osm_tags.description: Fishing Boat Wreck on the south west corner of Sozavarika Island.  It looks to be about 90 feet long, and possibly a blue deck and a white hull. Found in OpenStreetMap on 1 January 2018.  US Coast Guard contacted.  Might be old or might be new.
